comment: The two mistakes of a saved view (or of a story step with its own recipe) that both tools tell: no element, and an element that exists nowhere (run 0180, wave 024, W-3, issue #170). `view` is the id of the saved view, or of the story when `step` is given (the place of the step, from 1; a step that carries its own recipe is named step_NN). `cli` is, for each command, the `error:` lines it prints without the prefix (exit 1); `editor.problem` is what viewProblem (stepProblem for a step) returns, and it equals every line of `cli`. Left different on purpose: an unknown viewpoint (a warning for the command line, a status for the editor: the two tools do not draw the same viewpoints); a plateau that lacks the element (the command line warns and skips, the editor says the element is not in the plateau); a map pinned on missing entries (the command line refuses if any is missing, the editor only if none exists: behaviour, not words); a facet that removes the element (told once, run 0119); a view that names an element declared in no plateau of a layered workspace (the load sentence, K04 and K05); the states of the page own lists (`This view does not exist.`, `This step has no view.`). Read by ViewProblemCasesTest and view-problems.test.js.
